documentation.content: The Cloud Scheduler job run-daily-signal reported a failed attempt. This means either the Cloud Run target returned non-2xx or the job could not dispatch. Check Cloud Scheduler logs and Cloud Run logs for the same 5-minute window.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job" AND resource.labels.job_id="run-daily-signal" AND metric.type="cloudscheduler.googleapis.com/job/attempt_count" AND metric.labels.status!="success"
